svg.title: Number of India's coal-fired power plants with "critical" low coal stocks

g.text: Number of India's coal-fired power plants with "critical" low coal stocks

text.tspan: "Critical" is defined as having coal stocks <25% of the "normative" stock,
which is 20 days's worth assuming 85% load factor
